title: Japanese Mushroom Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese-inspired pilaf dish featuring sautéed mushrooms and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.notes: any combination of mushrooms works well

ingredients.name: pilaf
ingredients.notes: Japanese-style pilaf or regular pilaf works

ingredients.name: kissed golden oil
ingredients.notes: or any neutral oil with a high smoke point

instructions: 1. Heat the kissed golden oil in the dutch over medium-high heat.
2. Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the pilaf and stir to combine with the mushrooms.
4. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf is lightly toasted.
5. Add the soy sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
6. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed with salt and pepper.
7. Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
